title: 第十二章 一如既往的变态
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

夜晚，王都，绿宝石街。

马车在一栋宴会厅前停了下来，车夫上前将车门拉开，亚枫和伊尔莎下车，接着车夫满脸笑意地对亚枫伸出手，意思是要小费。

亚枫随手将手里用过的纸巾塞给他。

“谢谢，帮我丢一下。”

“...”

车夫骂骂咧咧的走了。

“车上连瓶水都没有还好意思要小费。”亚枫白了一眼。

“这里的车费居然要5金朗...简直是在抢钱啊...”伊尔莎心疼地看着钱包，里面就剩几枚硬币了，这下连面包都买不起了。

“放心，接下来不差钱了。”亚枫理了理衣领，今天他可是把自己唯一一件正装给穿过来了。

伊尔莎不知道他来这里干什么，还让自己穿上了最正式的一条宴会黑裙。

他们朝着别墅走去，她环顾四周，这里来了不少人，大多数都是文质彬彬，颇有学问的人物，看样子是什么宴会。

“今晚是王国文学晚会，各路作家，编剧，导演，记者都会到场，能带两名家属参加，而且主办方还是我的老东家，满天星杂志社，现在可是王国第一大传媒集团。”亚枫对她说道。

“所以，你是来这里，找别人借钱？”伊尔莎明白过来。

“当然，凭我的人品以及声望，借个几万块轻轻松松的。”亚枫说道。

“但你不是...”

“被封杀？呵，这个杂志社当初就是因为我才崛起的，现在的董事长当初都要给我端茶倒水，来参加个晚会怎么了？虽说后面给他们惹了点麻烦吧，”亚枫哼哼一笑。

“麻烦？什么麻烦？”

“也没啥，就是我被封杀之后又偷偷换小号继续创作，不过为了报复就在书里给王宫那些贵族上上下下的黑料都爆了个遍，被发现后就引发了王国大审查，杂志社被迫关停一个月。”亚枫说道。

“....”

“但就算如此，凭我在这里的影响力，每次都是想来就来，谁敢不让我进去？”亚枫说道。

他们来到大门口。

“不好意思，没有邀请函不能进入。”

门口的守卫将他们拦了下来。

亚枫皱起眉头，走到对方面前。

“新来的？”

“是。”

“知道我是谁吗？”

“不知道。”

“不知道就去问德兰克！告诉他你的摇钱树来了！”亚枫高声道。

门口两位迎宾的守卫对视一眼，也许是对方趾高气昂的报出了他们董事长的名字，还是有所忌惮，其中一个说请稍等，就先行离开。

Page (1/3)

Night, Royal Capital, Emerald Street.

The carriage stopped in front of a banquet hall. The coachman stepped forward and opened the door. Yafeng and Ilsa got out of the car. The coachman then extended his hand to Yafeng with a smile on his face, meaning he wanted a tip.

Yafeng casually handed him the used tissue in her hand.

"Thank you, throw it away for me."

"..."

The driver cursed and left.

"I didn't even have a bottle of water in the car and I had the nerve to ask for a tip." Ya Feng rolled his eyes.

"The fare here actually costs 5 gold crowns... It's just a money grab..." Ilsa looked at her wallet distressedly. There were only a few coins left in it. She couldn't even buy bread now.

"Don't worry, you won't be short of money next time." Yafeng straightened his collar. Today he wore his only formal suit.

Ilsa didn't know what he was doing here, so she put on the most formal black dress for the party.

They walked towards the villa, and she looked around. There were many people here, most of them were gentle and knowledgeable people. It looked like it was some kind of banquet.

"Tonight is the Kingdom Literature Gala. Writers, screenwriters, directors, and reporters from all walks of life will be present. I can bring two family members to participate, and the organizer is my old employer, Starry Star Magazine, which is now the largest media group in the Kingdom." Yafeng said to her.

"So, you are here to borrow money from others?" Ilsa understood.

"Of course, with my character and reputation, I can easily borrow tens of thousands of dollars." Ya Feng said.

"But you're not..."

"Banned? Haha, this magazine rose because of me. What happened when the current chairman had to bring me tea and water to attend a party? Although it may have caused some trouble for them later," Yafeng snorted.

"Trouble? What trouble?"

"It's nothing, it's just that after I was banned, I secretly changed my account and continued to write. However, in order to retaliate, I exposed all the dirty information about the nobles in the palace in the book. When it was discovered, it triggered a major review in the kingdom, and the magazine was forced to close for a month." Yafeng said.

"...."

"But even so, with my influence here, I can come whenever I want. Who dares not to let me in?" Ya Feng said.

They came to the gate.

"Sorry, you can't enter without an invitation."

The guard at the door stopped them.

Yafeng frowned and walked to the other party.

"New here?"

"Yes."

"Do you know who I am?"

"I don't know."

"If you don't know, just ask Delanke! Tell him your cash cow is here!" Ya Feng said loudly.

The two guards greeting guests at the door looked at each other. Perhaps they were still wary of the other party's arrogant announcement of their chairman's name. One of them said please wait a moment and left first.
